outcome.label: PM a) the scope of the work for the project shall be defined;
PM b) the tasks and resources necessary to complete the work shall be estimated (schedule, effort, cost, duration);
PM c) planning for the execution of the project shall be developed according to the scope and the tasks defined;
PM d) a software version control strategy shall be developed;
PM e) planning shall be reviewed and agreed by the customer;
PM f) progress of the project against the planning shall be monitored and reported;
PM g) risks shall be identified and monitored during the conduct of the project;
PM h) changes shall be addressed, analysed and evaluated for cost, schedule and technical impact;
PM i) relevant items of software configuration shall be identified and controlled including their storage, baseline, handling, and modifications;
PM j) releases of items shall be controlled and made available to relevant stakeholders;
PM k) product shall be completed and delivered to the customer as planning;
PM l) meetings with the work team and the customer shall be held to guarantee that work done complies with the project requirements and planning ;
PM m) agreements resulting from meetings shall be registered and tracked;
PM n) actions to correct planning problems and unachieved targets (schedule, effort, cost, duration) shall be taken;
PM o) project closure shall be performed to get the customer acceptance;
SI a) software requirements shall be defined;
SI b) software requirements shall be analysed for correctness and testability;
SI c) software requirements shall be agreed by the customer;
SI d) software requirements shall be baselined and communicated to work team and customer;
SI e) software architectural and detailed design shall be developed and baselined;
SI f) software architectural and detailed design shall describe the software components and their internal and external interfaces;
SI g) software components defined by the detailed design shall be produced;
SI h) unit test shall be performed to verify the consistency with requirements and the detailed design;
SI i) software shall be produced by integrating software components;
SI j) software shall be tested and verified, the results shall be recorded;
SI k) consistency and traceability between software requirements, software architectural, software detailed design and software components shall be established;
SI l) defects identified in reviews, traceability analysis, tests and verifications shall be corrected;
SI m) software configuration shall be integrated, baselined and stored in the project repository;

requirements are complete, unambiguous, and not contradictory. The results

Incorporate the requirements specification to the software
configuration in the baseline

corrections are made until the document is approved by DES. If significant
changes were needed, initiate a Change Request.

testing based on Requirements Specification and Software Design. Customer
provides testing data, if needed.

consistency among Requirements Specification, Software Design and Test
Cases and Test Procedures. The results found are documented in a Verification
Results and corrections are made until the document is approved.

Update the Traceability Record incorporating the Test Cases and Test
Procedures.

Incorporate the Software Design, and Traceability Record to the
Software Configuration as part of the baseline. Incorporate the Test Cases, and
Test Procedures to the Project Repository.

Construct or update Software Components based on the detailed part
of the Software Design.

Design or update unit test cases and apply them to verify that the
Software Components implements the detailed part of the Software Design.

Correct the defects found until successful unit test (reaching exit
criteria) is achieved.

Update the Traceability Record incorporating Software Components
constructed or modified.

Incorporate Software Components and Traceability Record to the
Software Configuration as part of the baseline.

Integrates the Software using Software Components and updates Test 
Cases and Test Procedures for integration testing, as needed.

Perform Software tests using Test Cases and Test Procedures for
integration and document results in Test Report.

Correct the defects found and perform regression test until exit
criteria is achieved.
Updates the Traceability Record, if appropriate.

Incorporate the Test Cases and Test Procedures, Software, Traceability
Record, Test Report to the Software Configuration as part of the baseline.
Document the Maintenance Documentation or update the current one.

Verify and obtain approval of the Maintenance Documentation. Verify
consistency of Maintenance Documentation with Software Configuration. The
results found are documented in a Verification Results and corrections are
made until the document is approved.

Incorporate the Maintenance Documentation as baseline for the
Software Configuration.
